prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0006",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 0,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01630-01630",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺は街の北側にある大きな屋敷に向かった。",
      "en": "I headed for the big mansion on the north side of town."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01636-01637",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "待たせたな",
      "en": "Sorry to keep you waiting."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01639-01640",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "屋敷の一室に通された俺の前に、\nレヴィアと異常に背の高い青年がドアを潜って現れた。",
      "en": "I was shown into a room in the mansion. Levia and an unusually tall young man appeared, ducking through the door."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01646-01647",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "お久しぶりです、セリカさん",
      "en": "It has been a while, Celica."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01649-01651",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "この人懐こそうな容貌をした目の細い青年はレフィン、\nレヴィアが最も信頼している部下で、\n唯一俺に食って掛かるレヴィアを止める事の出来る人間だ。",
      "en": "The young man with the narrow eyes and amiable face is Refin. He is Levia's most trusted subordinate, and the only one who can stop Levia when she gets angry with me."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01653-01654",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "レフィン、体の調子はもういいのか？",
      "en": "Refin, are you feeling better?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01656-01658",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レフィンは、先の大戦で敵の放った悪魔との戦いの時に、\nその身を張ってレヴィアを守り続けた為、\n相当な重傷を負っていた筈だったが……。",
      "en": "Refin was supposed to have been seriously injured. During the last great war, when fighting a demon unleashed by the enemy, he had risked his own body to keep protecting Levia..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01660-01661",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "はい、もうすっかり良くなりました",
      "en": "Yes, I am completely better now."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01663-01668",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "天井に頭が付きそうになるのが気になるのか、\nレフィンは僅かに身を屈めた状態で腕を動かして見せる。\nその巨体故か、確かにレフィンは回復が早く、人間とは\n思えぬ程に打たれ強い。\n心配することもなかったか……",
      "en": "Perhaps bothered by his head nearly touching the ceiling, Refin stooped slightly and showed me by moving his arm. Maybe due to his massive frame, he truly recovers quickly and is so resilient it is hard to believe he is human. I suppose there was no need to worry..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01674-01675",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "まだ、無理はするな",
      "en": "Still, don't overdo it."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01677-01677",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そのレフィンをレヴィアが優しく諫める。",
      "en": "Levia gently admonished Refin."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01683-01684",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "は、申し訳ありません",
      "en": "Ah, I am sorry."
    }
  ]
}
